# delete_all_recent_message_reactions_from_sender()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.delete_all_recent_message_reactions_from_sender`

## Signature

```python
async def delete_all_recent_message_reactions_from_sender(chat_id: Union[int, str], sender_id: Union[int, str]) -> bool: ...
```

## Documentation

Delete all recent reactions added by a sender in a chat.

> [!NOTE]
> Requires the *can_delete_messages* administrator right in the chat.

**Available to:** User accounts and bots.

### Parameters

- **`chat_id`** (`int` | `str`)
  Unique identifier (int) or username (str) of the target group or channel.

- **`sender_id`** (`int` | `str`)
  Unique identifier (int) or username (str) of the user or chat whose reactions will be deleted.

### Returns

`bool`: On success, True is returned.

### Example

```python
await app.delete_all_recent_message_reactions_from_sender(chat_id, user_id)
```
